summary: Shipped the round-1 builder pass for Team Builder by migrating role preference handling to the required 6-point distribution model, simplifying saved-player management, preserving the 6-candidate/team-swap flow, refreshing docs, and regenerating the static bundle.
completed_work: Replaced the old ranked-role preference model with `preferencePoints` across runtime state, candidate/editor metadata, and saved-player persistence, with default `2/2/2` handling and legacy `preferenceOrder -> 3/2/1` migration.

Updated the roster UI to Korean point steppers for `탱커 / 딜러 / 힐러`, guaranteed integer totals of 6 at all times, and refreshed candidate/editor badges to show assigned-role preference points instead of rank labels.
Simplified the saved-player library into a name-first list with exact-10 load gating, per-row delete, clear-all delete, selection reconciliation, and canonical TSV reload/reset behavior.
Refreshed automated coverage for point normalization, legacy storage migration, save/load/delete flows, swap recalculation, responsive contracts, and fake DOM rerender cleanup.
Updated `README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` to match the shipped 6-point workflow and documented the non-blocking browser/mobile smoke gap for this iteration.
Regenerated `dist/` from the current source with the updated frontend behavior.

verification.result: Passed while validating the updated point-based swap/editor expectations.

known_gaps: `npm run test:browser` was not executed in this round, so real browser/mobile smoke evidence is still absent. The current spec marks that gap as non-blocking.
handoff_notes: Saved-player persistence now reads the new `team-builder.saved-players.v2` payload first and falls back to legacy `v1` data when present.
Candidate ordering still follows the required balance rules only; preference points are display/edit metadata and do not act as a ranking key.
`dist/` reflects the latest source changes from the successful build run.
